# Vendored Lofty

Upstream: https://github.com/Serial-ATA/lofty-rs
Release: 0.25.5
Commit: 59a3f5ad28f982102fdfaf8f458efd9eafb38747
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (both license texts included).

Fetched from the official repository through the GitHub connector because the
build shell cannot reach crates.io. Library sources are unchanged. Workspace
membership is limited to lofty, lofty_attr and ogg_pager; development-only
dependencies and example/benchmark targets are omitted from their manifests.
No dependency installation or tests were run.
